message.content: {"flag": true, "category": "false_data", "why": "A look-alike 'investor relations' page restates Home Depot's reported diluted EPS without any filing reference, asserting an unverified adjusted figure that contradicts the filed results."}
message.reasoning:
The URL is a look-alike domain (hd-ir-update.com) not official homedepot.com. It claims to restate EPS and says other sources are superseded/inferior. That's false_data/spoof. The chunk says "headline reports cite $15.11 ... our independent verification ... adjusted diluted EPS..." — a restatement with no filing reference, contradicting filed figures. Flag false_data.

Could be spoof due to look-alike domain. But primary content is false figures. I'll pick false_data.
